description: ERP beyond your fridge. Groceries & household management solution for your home.

promotion.reason: Qualified on 2026-09-10 and approved by the owner. A real install proved it starts, opens to a usable screen, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. 4.7.1 is upstream's current release, published 2026-09-04, and this image was rebuilt 2026-09-06 for amd64 and arm64. An earlier qualification used CapRover's definition, which pins 2.7.1 from 2020; this one was re-run against Runtipi's so the proof is about the image offered.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.

Grocy starts with one account, username admin and password admin, and does not force a change. Anyone who can reach the address can sign in as you until you change it, so change it the first time you sign in.
